title: General Text
description:
A preprocessing component that segments large bodies of text into intelligently sized 
chunks for downstream processing. It recursively splits content based on a hierarchy 
of separators (such as paragraphs, sentences, or words) preserving context while ensuring 
each chunk meets token or length constraints. This enables efficient handling of lengthy 
documents in workflows like embedding, retrieval, or LLM-based generation. Ideal for 
preparing content for language models where context length and coherence are critical.
